title: Recall Familiar Quality Words at a Distance
label: ch:pa-quality-words-at-a-distance
canDo: I can retrieve five already-taught Punjabi quality words in familiar food and truth contexts without confusing this separate review with the scored A1 writing tasks.

payoff.summary: At a long interval, identify stale, ripe, unripe, true, and false from short familiar cues without introducing new Punjabi or borrowing the timed writing checkpoints.
